meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解释任意提示的含义与作用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在终端界面看到提示却想知道它的实际用法。
copy.tagline_en: Explain the meaning and purpose of any tip you see.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you come across tips in a text interface and want to know what they really mean.

howto.what: 它会解释 senpi 的任意一条 tip——启动 tip、工作 tip,或 TUI 里的 Tip: 行,用你提问时用的语言给出深入说明,并引用它实际读过的源码文件路径。
howto.when: 当你问某条 tip 是什么意思、某个被 tip 提到的功能怎么工作,或你能看到哪些 tip 时触发。

say.text: 刚才那行 Tip: 是什么意思?

say.text: Fable 5 拒绝后那条提示背后做了什么?
say.note: 展开 fallback-architect 的完整管线

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些 tip?看不到的为什么?
say.note: 按你的 settings.json 与 tip 历史回答

howto.what_en: Explains any senpi tip in depth — startup tips, working tips, or `Tip:` lines in the TUI — in the language you asked in, citing the source file paths it actually read.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: Reads the live tip list, then explains the mechanism

say_en.text: What runs behind the tip after a Fable 5 refusal?
Which tips can I see, and why are some hidden?
say_en.note: Answers from your settings.json and tip history
